newsitem.title: USA: Instrumentation Lab wins FDA clearance.
newsitem.headline: Instrumentation Lab wins FDA clearance.

text.p: Instrumentation Laboratory S.p.A. said Monday that it received Food and Drug Administration clearance to market the Synthesis family of Critical Care instruments in the United States.
The Synthesis is the company's first instrument to fully integrate blood gas and electrolyte with on-line CO-Oximetry.

The company said it believes that this family of instruments will be a leader in technical innovation due to its unique CO-Oximetry measurement technology, which does not require cell hemolysis (i.e. breaking of cell walls) and, therefore, eliminates the need for expensive and failure-promoting sample pathway splitting.
